secrets.name: The Reader's Room
secrets.text: Behind the bookcase is the reader's room: a narrow bed, a coat on the hook, the kettle just off the boil. Everything is ready for them to come back. You have the feeling it would be rude to wait.

meta.label: The Last Reader
meta.blurb: Every lamp in the hall is out but one. Under it a book lies open, a chair is pushed back, the tea is still hot. You are sure, quite sure, that you are the last reader. Then who was this?
